name: Viperia
_turns: How many turns a game lasts (the arena doc); the turn track at the table's end has a slot for each.
_grid: One character per tile, row 0 = the far side (player 2), last row = player 1's side. Each character is defined in the legend. From the old map image (maps/viperia.jpg), 16 wide by 15 deep: a jungle floor split up by vine-covered walls two levels tall (nothing crosses them), purple poison pools, small water wells, trap doors in numbered pairs and three flags.
_legend: level = height step (0 = lowest); tiles interact only within 1 level. surface picks the look from the palette. sink = the surface sits this many world units lower than its level (a look only: the pools count as ground level). solid = nothing can stand on or cross it (no snap point). marker = something on the tile (painted, or a 3D piece with piece: true). Trap doors are numbered by pair (two of each).
_board: The published board files the map picker uses (from tools/build_board.py; update when a new version is published), then run tools/build_arena_index.py.
_table: Image for the table around the board (placeholder until the arena gets its own).
_textures: Placeholders from tools/draw_placeholders.py: jungle floor, purple poison sludge, mossy stone wall tops, vine-covered wall faces.
